The '''Corus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Wyl sector/Legends|Wyl sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], and a haven for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].
